Name: Ewesome Ewes (VMV)
Author: emjess
Description:
[size=3][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Quick edit & recolour of siamece's sheep sprites to turn them into reskins for Lumisteria's Visit Mount Vapius ewes, to feed my never-ending quest to have ALL the animals in this style. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Replaces all 3 colours of the ewes and babies from VMV via CP.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I had a really hard time getting the patch to apply, so please do let me know if anything isn't working. [/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stick the file in your mods folder. [/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8](not required) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] for matching sheep, cows, etc.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece]siamece[/url] - these are still largely their sheep sprites [/size][/color]
